column4: Two streamed passes over the batch source share ~40 per-batch accumulators (residual and redundancy sums, w/tau, the MDB reservoir, the quadrant counters, external reliability, progress); the inner loop runs once per batch over all n rows, so splitting it means threading that state through every call. ~117 lines are the help. Seam if ever split: one local function per pass with a state struct.

The five-level verdict is read top-down as the report's specification: each LEVEL block is a run of independent checks on D that append to one findings list through the nested push. Seam if ever split: one local function per level returning its findings (the %% LEVEL headers).

~360 lines are the help, which documents Ellmer's ten steps and the measured decisions behind them (WP-98, R7-09, R7-11, R7-13, WP-111). The body is the one outer loop whose state -- S, the pool-group laws, the keyed arc factors, the pinned arc identity, the robust factors, the history -- every step reads and writes; the per-arc and per-pass work is already in local functions (sweepArcs, oneArc, robustSweep, arcFactorMap, whitenessRow).

~165 lines are the help (the rejection theory and its guards). The body is one iterative rejection loop around a rank-one downdate of the block cofactor whose state (Q, x, vPv, the rejected set) each guard checks before the next step; the helpers (scanWorst, blockResolveAccumulator, maskedBatch, guardContamination since WP-137) are local functions.

~270 lines are the help (the full loader contract). The body validates and resolves every option once and builds the closures; the per-day and per-arc work lives in local functions (dayOf, batchOf, priorArc, buildScopePlan, ...).

The ONE dispatcher over the seven temporal laws (diag, acf, psd, arma, var, custom) and the composition with the per-epoch Cep and the nugget: each law is a short case, and the help (~190 lines) is the reference users read through doc lsqvce.engine.covModel. The psd modes, the composition and the nugget are already local functions (psdModel, composeWithCep, nuggetRows, filterMemoryOf). Seam if ever split: one local function per law.

Three phases -- the broadcast cofactor state, the enumeration of the arc-tasks, the mapreduce over them -- plus the optional Hutchinson cross-check; ~125 lines are the help. The per-arc work and the folds are already local functions (arcTask, foldTask, combinePartials, arcLeverageAndResidual). Seam if ever split: one local function per phase.

~225 lines are the help (the leverage split, its probe statistics, the streamed redundancy and their ACCURACY, WP-139 crossing 400). The body is one Hutchinson estimate in five phases that share the probe block Z and the Cholesky of N -- the factorisation, the per-system Schur factors G_s Z, the group bookkeeping, the one data sweep, the trace and diagonal per group; the per-arc probe work is already a local function (arcCommonProbe). Seam if ever split: one local function per phase with a state struct.

~150 lines are the help (the residual contract, its sigma0 and dof bookkeeping, and the dated record of each change to them -- WP-140's stamp crossed 400). The body is one replay of the retained stores, per system and day, whose sums (vtv, m, the rows of weight 0, the parameter count) every arc adds to, then the prior's share, sigma0 and the per-obsType quick-look; the per-arc work is already a local function (arcResiduals). Seam if ever split: the quick-look and its report as a local function.
